books.title: The Silent Architecture
books.subtitle: Memory and Monoliths in Post-War Europe
books.shortDescription: A profound exploration of the stone monuments and quiet municipal facades that survived the crucible of the twentieth century.
books.fullDescription: In The Silent Architecture, Dr. Alistair Finch guides readers through the forgotten corridors of Europe’s post-war reconstruction. By examining concrete structures, municipal courtyards, and silent public archives, Finch excavates how stone and glass absorbed collective grief and preserved unspoken resilience across generations. Richly documented and poetically rendered.
books.seoTitle: The Silent Architecture by Dr. Alistair Finch | Aratha Publication
books.seoDescription: Discover The Silent Architecture by Dr. Alistair Finch. An editorial investigation of post-war memory and architectural resilience, published by Aratha.

books.title: Tides of Finistère
books.subtitle: A Novel of Atlantic Solitude
books.shortDescription: An atmospheric literary novel set against the misted cliffs of western Brittany, tracing a family mystery hidden beneath ocean tides.
books.fullDescription: Set on the wind-swept bluffs of western France, Tides of Finistère follows Claire, an archivist who inherits an abandoned granite cottage perched above the tempestuous Atlantic. As winter storms roll across the peninsula, she unearths a series of unsent letters dating back to 1943. Moreau crafts a mesmerizing tale of devotion, longing, and redemption.
books.seoTitle: Tides of Finistère by Camilla Moreau | Aratha Publication
books.seoDescription: Read Tides of Finistère, Camilla Moreau’s evocative literary novel published by Aratha Publication.

books.title: Principia Organica
books.subtitle: Navigating Chaos in Modern Enterprise Systems
books.shortDescription: A pragmatic, philosophical manifesto for organizational builders who prioritize enduring clarity over volatile hypergrowth.
books.fullDescription: In Principia Organica, Siddharth Nair synthesizes classical systemic logic with real-world enterprise engineering. Rather than chasing fragile productivity trends, Nair outlines principles for building institutions that absorb shock, cultivate internal trust, and outlast market volatility.

books.title: Echoes of the Herbarium

books.shortDescription: A delicate tapestry of verse honoring the fragility of wildflowers, alpine shadows, and silent contemplation.
books.fullDescription: Echoes of the Herbarium unites Elena Rostova’s celebrated verse cycles with hand-drawn botanical illustrations. Each poem acts as a pressed flower: capturing a fleeting moment of wonder, twilight stillness, and emotional intimacy.

faqs.question: What is the fundamental difference between your traditional publishing and assisted publishing tracks?
faqs.answer: Under our Traditional Publishing imprint, Aratha covers all editorial, design, production, and distribution costs. Selection is competitive, handled through our editorial committee, and authors receive contractual royalties. Under Assisted Self-Publishing, authors retain 100% of rights and receive 100% of retailer net proceeds while contracting our specialized editorial and production team to achieve publishing-house grade excellence.

faqs.question: Do I need to submit a completed manuscript to begin an enquiry?
faqs.answer: No. While a completed manuscript is required for final editorial acceptance and typesetting, we warmly accept concept proposals, chapter outlines, or sample excerpts for initial consultation and manuscript evaluation.

faqs.question: How long does the typical publishing journey take from submission to print release?
faqs.answer: Depending on the depth of editorial development required, a typical literary or scholarly book takes between 4 to 8 months. This timeline ensures thorough developmental editing, typographic refinement, physical proofs, and pre-order distribution alignment.

faqs.question: Who owns the copyright and creative rights to my work?
faqs.answer: The author remains the exclusive copyright holder of their original literary work at all times. In assisted publishing contracts, you grant only non-exclusive distribution licenses. In traditional publishing agreements, term-limited regional publishing rights are negotiated with transparent reversions.

faqs.question: Can Aratha handle ISBN registration and legal deposits?
faqs.answer: Yes. For titles published under the Aratha imprint, we assign official registered ISBNs and perform mandatory national library deposits. For independent authors, we provide step-by-step guidance to register ISBNs directly in your own name or imprint.

faqs.question: How are manuscript uploads kept secure and confidential?
faqs.answer: All manuscript files uploaded through our portal are stored in protected private storage with encrypted transit and restricted staff permissions. Manuscripts are never indexed by search engines or shared outside the assigned editorial review committee.

sitePages.title: About Aratha Publication

content.intro: Aratha Publication is an independent literary and scholarly publishing house committed to enduring words, thoughtful scholarship, and artisanal book design.
content.mission: To bridge visionary writers with discerning readers through uncompromising editorial craft, ethical publishing practices, and beautiful physical books.
content.vision: To build a lasting sanctuary for literature, academic thought, and narrative expression that withstands transient digital noise.
content.philosophy: A book is not merely informational inventory; it is an enduring cultural object. Every comma, typeface selection, paper weight, and margin is an act of stewardship.
content.approach: We treat every manuscript with bespoke attention. Rather than conveyor-belt production, our editors and typographers work intimately with authors through iterative revisions and classical typesetting.
